component.name: App Entries
component.summary: Hide, show and edit app launcher entries

description.p: A GTK 4 app with a Material 3 Expressive style for choosing which installed applications appear in your app launcher. It uses standard freedesktop.org desktop-entry overrides in your own folder, so it never changes system files itself; uninstalling a package runs your package manager in your own terminal.

ul.li: Every installed app in one searchable grid, including Flatpak, Snap and AppImage apps
Hide or show apps with one switch, or several at once, with Undo
Edit any app's entry, and find leftover files, missing programs and duplicates
Make launchers for programs, scripts and commands (in one terminal or several), and web apps that open a site in its own window
Styled icons from thousands of symbols or your own SVGs
Turn login programs on and off
Choose which app opens links, folders and each kind of file
Uninstall Flatpak, Snap, AppImage, Steam and package-manager apps, showing what else uses them first
Shortcuts to helper apps like Flatseal, Gear Lever and ProtonUp-Qt
A history of every change, each with Undo
Export your changes to another computer, and update from GitHub with one button
Uninstall apps, whatever installed them, after seeing what else needs them
Shortcuts to helper apps like Flatseal, Gear Lever and ProtonUp-Qt
Launchers can run commands, in one terminal or several
Starts about twice as fast, most of all with large icon themes
The accent colour can follow your desktop's, live
Palettes: Catppuccin, Gruvbox, Nord, Rosé Pine, Tokyo Night, Everforest and Solarized
Settings are kept on systems without a D-Bus session
Default apps: choose which app opens links, email, folders, PDFs, pictures, videos, music and archives
Web apps: dark mode, and a window name for docks and window rules
Cleaner edges on bordered icon tiles
History of every change, each with Undo, kept between sessions
Web apps can be deleted from their card
Paste SVG lists where to find icons
Hide, show and edit app entries, one at a time or several at once
Launchers, web apps and styled icons
Autostart, AppImage removal, export and import, and updates
